claims: NATO is the North Atlantic Treaty Organization.
NATO is an intergovernmental military alliance.
NATO was founded by the North Atlantic Treaty.
The North Atlantic Treaty is also known as the Washington Treaty.
NATO was founded to counter Soviet influence.
NATO has 32 member states as of 2024.
NATO's member states are principally in Europe and North America.
NATO's members include the US, UK, Canada, and most of Europe.
NATO's headquarters is in Brussels, Belgium.
NATO's Article 5 is the principle that an armed attack against one member is considered an attack against all members.
Article 5 was triggered for the first time after the 9/11 attacks.
NATO is also known as North Atlantic Alliance.
NATO is also known as The Atlantic Alliance.
NATO is also known as Western Alliance.
NATO is also known as OTAN.
OTAN is Organisation du traité de l'Atlantique nord in French.
